Next, I will verify unit tests and proceed to pull request submission.

I'm currently focused on updating and verifying unit tests for the deployer SPIs. My next step is to conduct comprehensive integration testing across all variants to confirm the consistent reporting of the `UNDEPLOYED` status. This will ensure accurate behavior for streams lacking deployment context.

technical_and_design_decisions: Decouple deployer SPI implementations (Lattice, K8s, Mesos) from the monolithic admin project into dedicated individual repositories with standardized build (Maven/Gradle) and CI pipeline setups.
Introduce `UNDEPLOYED` as a first-class enum state in the common deployer SPI status model (e.g., AppStatus / DeploymentState).

Update deployer state resolution logic across Cloud Foundry, Lattice, Kubernetes, and Mesos implementations to return `UNDEPLOYED` instead of `UNKNOWN` when no active deployment context or resource exists for a stream.
assumptions: The existing codebase for Mesos SPI is functionally complete and primarily requires repository setup, packaging, and PR submission.
Required build infrastructure, repository hosting permissions, and CI/CD pipelines are available to create new Git repositories.
A single developer will perform repository restructuring, core SPI refactoring, individual deployer updates, and unit/integration testing sequentially.

activities.activity_name: Repository Creation and Configuration for SPIs
activities.activity_description: Extract and set up separate repositories for Lattice SPI (U2), K8s SPI (U3), and Mesos SPI (U4), including build scripts, dependency management, and CI workflows.

activities.activity_name: Mesos SPI PR Preparation and Submission
activities.activity_description: Clean up existing Mesos SPI codebase, verify existing tests against the standalone repo layout, and submit the PR (U1).

activities.activity_name: Core Deployer SPI Enum and Status Mapping Update
activities.activity_description: Add `UNDEPLOYED` status to core deployer SPI contracts and update common deployment state handling for streams missing deployment contexts (U7).

activities.activity_name: Cloud Foundry SPI Undeployed Status Integration
activities.activity_description: Implement `UNDEPLOYED` status logic in CF SPI deployer to replace `UNKNOWN` state for undeployed resources and update unit tests (U5).
Implement `UNDEPLOYED` status logic in Lattice SPI deployer in its new repository and update unit tests (U6).
Implement `UNDEPLOYED` status logic in Kubernetes SPI deployer in its new repository and update unit tests (U8).
Execute integration tests across all updated deployer SPI variants to ensure consistent status reporting for existing and unmanaged streams.
